_about: Settings for circuit-diagram-skill. Edit values; keys starting with _ are comments.
_symbol_standard: US = IEEE zig-zag resistors (American textbooks); IEC = rectangular resistors (European)
_labels: what resistor/capacitor labels show: name_and_value (R1 and 4.00 Ω), value (4.00 Ω only), name (R1 only)
_dpi: resolution of the PNG; 220 prints well, 110 is fine for screens
_output_dir: where files go when --out gives no folder; relative to the current working directory
_solve: true = also write the answers and worked solution (same as the --solve flag)
